text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: KV cache eviction spike detected. 90th p95 latency for small-seq requests > 600ms across us-east-1. Alerting eng-oncall.

Devon: got it, oncall here. seeing big increase in cache miss evictions and batch amplification. is this a rollout? any recent batch-config changes?

Sasha: I'm seeing a spike in continuous-batching overhead after yesterday's runtime bump (rtd-3.2.1). KV slot churn up 4x, evictions up 3x in 10m window.

Raj: rtd-3.2.1 included a batching heuristic tweak that increases microbatch sizes when tail-latency is low. guess it misfired on bursty tenant slices.

Maria: infra shows node-side memory pressure on inference-pool-a, OOM-kill on 2 pods. autoscaler tried to add capacity but keep getting eviction loops.

Devon: ok triage plan: 1) immediate safety toggle to reduce batch size / disable continuous ramping 2) per-customer override for high-throughput tenants to prevent cascading cache pressure 3) apply hotfix to runtime in canary -> full rollout. I'll coordinate.

Devon: toggling feature-flag:batch_auto_ramp -> off globally to stop growth.

Devon: run: ```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"batch_auto_ramp","value":false}' https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/toggle
```

ops-bot: feature-flag batch_auto_ramp set to false by @Devon at 2026-03-15T15:12:10Z :white_check_mark:

Sasha: metric check: within 30s evictions trend reversed, but latency still high for some tenant slices. looks like pre-warmed KV cache is still being thrash-evicted.

Tim: Support: we have 3 customer-reported incidents (cust-42, cust-omega, cust-gamma) — all complaining of slow responses. ETA updates?

Devon: we're applying per-customer hard cap to batching for those tenants (override to batch_size=1, no KV aggression) to stabilize.

Devon: override command (per-customer) ```
POST /admin/tenants/cust-omega/overrides
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "overrides": {"batch_size":1, "cache_policy":"no_ramp"}
}
```

ops-bot: tenant override applied for cust-omega, cust-gamma, cust-42 by @Devon

Sasha: after overrides, those tenants' p95 dropped from ~900ms to ~180ms. Good. Remaining elevated latency seems concentrated on long-tail multi-tenant inference streams that kept KV churn.

Raj: I pushed a hotpatch branch that reverts the aggressive ramp heuristic and adds a safety cap for microbatch growth. Patch id: rtd-3.2.1-hotfix-rc1.

Raj: canary deploy to 3 pods in us-east-1 (low-traffic slice) now.```kubectl rollout restart ds/rt-runtime-canary -n inference-canary```

Maria: infra: reserving 6 extra nodes for canary and to avoid autoscaler noise. k8s events show one node flapping but drains succeeded.

Devon: monitoring hooks: Sasha, please watch KV evictions, cache-hit ratio, microbatch size histogram. Also set an alert if eviction rate > 20/min for 5m.

Sasha: on it. setting short-term grafana panel and a pager rule.

ops-bot: canary pods now running rtd-3.2.1-hotfix-rc1. Initial metrics: KV evictions down 70% on canary traffic.

Raj: good signal. I'll promote to staggered canary across two regions with a 10% traffic shift per 5m. Using routing policy:region+latency fallback.

Devon: do not do a global immediate rollout; we need to watch cost and cache behavior. Rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100. Pause at each step and validate. If eviction increases by >15% at any step, rollback to previous.

Alice: Product: we should prepare customer comms for the three impacted tenants and have a notice ready if more customers are affected. Tim, work with me on message.

Tim: drafting short note: "We're investigating high latency for some requests; we've applied targeted mitigations and are deploying a fix. We'll update in 30 minutes or upon resolution."

Devon: handoff for night: I'm oncall for another 25m then Sasha will take primary. Handoff checklist: flags toggled (batch_auto_ramp=false), per-tenant overrides active for cust-42/omega/gamma, canary running rtd-3.2.1-hotfix-rc1, staggered rollout started at 15:20Z -> currently at 10% in us-east-1.

Sasha: I have watch and will escalate if evictions trend up or any new tenant shows >500ms p95.

Devon: if we need immediate rollback use: ```
kubectl label node inference=false && kubectl rollout undo deployment/rt-runtime -n inference
```

ops-bot: incident summary saved to /incidents/2187654329-kv-paging-cascade (auto).

Devon: final note: we should plan a postmortem once stable — root cause appears to be heuristic edge-case with bursty tenant patterns; consider adding regression tests that simulate tenant-slice burstiness.

Alice: agreed. I'll create PM ticket to own the postmortem and customer follow-ups.

Tim: will send interim customer updates in 10 minutes.

Sasha: metrics are stabilizing, evictions down system-wide ~55%, latency trending toward baseline. I'll keep watch.

Devon: handing off to @Sasha — thanks team. :thumbsup:

Sasha: acknowledged, taking over.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident severity reduced to SEV3. No active pages.
